"""RSR-1 replay oracle (RSR-C05 step v). Usage: replay.py <before-root> <after-root> <name>.

import sqlite3, sys, json, glob, collections

def opn(root):

SQ = chr(39)
def inline_mods_at(path, line):
    """Names of the inline `mod <name> {` bodies that enclose `line` (1-based) in the corpus file, outermost first.
    Brace-depth scan that skips line comments, block comments, string and char literals; independent of the extractor."""
    if corpus is None: return []
    try: src = open(corpus + "/" + path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    except OSError: return []
    import re as _re
    stack = []  # (name, depth_at_open)
    depth = 0; i = 0; n = len(src); ln = 1; pending = None; result = None
    mod_re = _re.compile(r"\bmod\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*$")
    while i < n:
        ch = src[i]
        if ch == "\n":
            ln += 1
            if ln == line: result = [nm for nm, d in stack]
            i += 1; continue
        if src.startswith("//", i):
            j = src.find("\n", i); i = n if j < 0 else j; continue
        if src.startswith("/*", i):
            j = src.find("*/", i + 2); seg = src[i:(n if j < 0 else j + 2)]; ln += seg.count("\n"); i = n if j < 0 else j + 2; continue
        if ch == "\"":
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and src[j] != "\"":
                if src[j] == "\\": j += 1
                j += 1
            ln += src[i:j].count("\n"); i = j + 1; continue
        if ch == SQ and i + 2 < n and (src[i + 2] == SQ or (src[i + 1] == "\\" and i + 3 < n and src[i + 3] == SQ)):
            i = i + 3 if src[i + 2] == SQ else i + 4; continue
        if ch == "{":
            head = src[max(0, src.rfind("\n", 0, i) + 1):i].strip()
            m = mod_re.search(head)
            if m: stack.append((m.group(1), depth))
            depth += 1; i += 1; continue
        if ch == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if stack and stack[-1][1] == depth: stack.pop()
            i += 1; continue
        i += 1
    if line == 1: result = []
    return result if result is not None else []

Q_UNRES = """select f.path, u.target_key, u.line_start, u.metadata_json, u.basis_code, u.classification, u.type

def dir_sccs(file_edges, owners, is_test):
    """SCCs (size>=2) of the directory graph of the default view: certain file imports whose importer is not a test file, mapped to owning directory modules; sorted member tuples."""
    adj = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for s, t in file_edges:
        if is_test.get(s): continue
        a, b = owners.get(s), owners.get(t)
        if a is None or b is None or a == b: continue
        adj[a].add(b)
    index = {}; low = {}; on = set(); st = []; out = []; counter = [0]
    sys.setrecursionlimit(100000)
    def strong(v):
        index[v] = low[v] = counter[0]; counter[0] += 1; st.append(v); on.add(v)

            elif w in on: low[v] = min(low[v], index[w])
